create.name: Philip Carr-Gomm
create.bio:
Philip Carr-Gomm, an English psychologist, writer and teacher of Druidry, lives on the South Downs in Sussex. As a teenager he studied Druidry with Ross Nichols, who had founded OBOD, the Druid order he would later lead. Asked to take it on in 1988, he guided it for more than thirty years while it grew into one of the world's largest Druid groups. He studied psychology at University College London, went on to train in psychosynthesis psychotherapy, play therapy, sophrology and Montessori education, and later qualified to teach mindfulness meditation and Yoga Nidra.

In his teaching, nature spirituality meets Western psychology and the broader perennial wisdom tradition. He works through conversation, storytelling, poetry, ritual, meditation and oracles drawn from plants and animals. Of the twenty or so books he has written or co-written, the best known include Druid Mysteries and The Book of English Magic, along with two decks made with his wife Stephanie, The DruidCraft Tarot and The Druid Animal Oracle. He offers online courses through his own platforms and The Shift Network, gives talks and workshops, presents the long-running YouTube series Tea with a Druid, and founded the Sophrology Institute.

books.title: The Druid Animal Oracle: Working with the sacred animals of the Druid tradition
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm and Stephanie Carr-Gomm
books.description: A book-and-card set presenting the animals held sacred in the Celtic and Druid traditions, with their lore and guidance on using the cards for reflection and divination. Co-written with Stephanie Carr-Gomm and illustrated by Will Worthington.

books.title: The DruidCraft Tarot: Use the Magic of Wicca and Druidry to Guide Your Life
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm and Stephanie Carr-Gomm
books.description: A 78-card tarot deck and guidebook that weaves together the imagery of Wicca and Druidry, set in the landscapes and seasonal festivals of the British Isles. Co-created with Stephanie Carr-Gomm.

books.title: Druid Mysteries: Ancient Wisdom for the 21st Century
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm
books.description: An accessible introduction to the history and practice of Druidry, from its ancient roots to the modern revival, and how its nature-based spirituality can be lived today.

books.title: What Do Druids Believe?
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm
books.description: A short book in Granta's 'What Do We Believe?' series that sets out the core ideas of contemporary Druidry and how Druids relate to nature, ritual and other faiths.

books.title: The Book of English Magic: A History
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm and Richard Heygate
books.description: A broad history of magic in England, from prehistoric sites and Merlin to alchemists, cunning folk, ritual magicians and modern witchcraft, with places to visit and practices to try. Co-written with Richard Heygate.

books.title: The Druid Plant Oracle: Working With the Magical Flora of the Druid Tradition
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm and Stephanie Carr-Gomm
books.description: A companion to The Druid Animal Oracle, this set covers trees, herbs, flowers and fungi from Druid lore, with a card for each plant and guidance on its meaning. Co-written with Stephanie Carr-Gomm.

books.title: The Druid Way: A Journey through an Ancient Landscape
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm
books.description: A walk through the South Downs landscape near his home, used as a frame for exploring Druid teachings on nature, myth and the inner journey.

books.title: Lessons in Magic: A Guide to Making Your Dreams Come True
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm
books.description: A practical guide to working with magical principles such as intention, imagination and ritual to bring more creativity and meaning into everyday life.

books.title: Seek Teachings Everywhere: Combining Druid Spirituality with Other Traditions
books.author: Philip Carr-Gomm and Peter Owen Jones
books.description: A collection exploring how Druidry can sit alongside and learn from other spiritual paths, including Christianity, Buddhism and Wicca. Edited with the Revd Peter Owen Jones.

courses.title: The Psychology of Spiritual Awakening
courses.description: An 18-week live online training that brings together Western psychology, neuroscience and esoteric frameworks to map personal growth and the obstacles to it. Recordings are available for self-paced study.

courses.title: The Way of the Druid
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course introducing Druidry as a path of nature spirituality, with Celtic lore, meditation practices and ritual.

courses.title: Druid Wisdom for Psycho-Spiritual Healing
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course using storytelling, guided journeys and Druid teachings to deepen the connection with nature, ancestry and the self.

courses.title: Journey to Merlin’s Isle to Receive the Seven Gifts of the Druids
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course framed as a pilgrimage through sacred wells, stone circles, groves and burial mounds, linking the landscape with seven inner gifts.

courses.title: Lessons in Magic
courses.description: An online video and audio course on using magical principles creatively to enrich your own life and support others, based on his book of the same name.

courses.title: Transformation Through Tarot
courses.description: A multimedia course with Steve Hounsome on using the tarot for self-development: the Major Arcana as archetypes, the court cards as aspects of personality and the minor cards in daily life.

courses.title: The Energy Body in Tarot: A Guided Practice Through the Seven Chakras
courses.description: An online class with Steve Hounsome that pairs tarot cards with the seven chakras as a guided contemplative practice.

courses.title: The Seven Valleys: The Soul's Journey Towards Freedom
courses.description: A self-study programme built on an ancient Persian Sufi story of seven valleys, used for psycho-spiritual development and as a contemplation on the passage through life and death. Includes the book by Philip Carr-Gomm and RoMa Johnson.

courses.title: Sophrology Level One
courses.description: A mentored online foundation course in sophrology, a method combining breathing, gentle movement and visualisation for deep relaxation and personal development. The first of four levels.

free_resources.title: The Garden of Flowing in Perpetual Happiness: A Meditation Retreat at Home
free_resources.description: A free online retreat of twelve sessions combining poetry, spiritual teachings and lying-down guided meditation in the style of Yoga Nidra, which he calls Druid Nidra. Includes video, audio and a community space.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @PhilipCarrGomm 17.3K subscribers (channel page, 30 Oct 2026); Instagram @philipcarrgomm and Facebook philip.carrgomm counts could not be read (no counts served to curl/WebFetch) → readable total ~17k → local_hero
flags: Instagram and Facebook counts could not be read; as long-time head of OBOD and author of 20 books his reach is probably larger than ~17k, so local_hero may be low — a human should check.
Email pa@druidry.org is his assistant Maria's address (published on his contact page); it is an OBOD domain address.
His About page still says he leads OBOD; to my knowledge he stepped down as Chosen Chief around 2020, so the bio says he guided it 'for more than three decades' rather than that he leads it now.
Kept the Shift course 'Druid Wisdom for Psycho-Spiritual Healing': 'healing' in the title but no condition named; the page mentions reduced stress. Borderline.
The Druid Way is listed with its Kindle ASIN (B0CYTN519D); the amazon.com paperback/audio listing found was the Audible edition only.
Druid Plant Oracle uses the 2007 St Martin's US edition (0312369778) because the current edition's amazon.com page credits only Stephanie Carr-Gomm.
Several items are co-authored with his wife Stephanie Carr-Gomm, and two tarot courses with Steve Hounsome.
The Shift course prices for The Way of the Druid and Druid Wisdom are sale prices ($297; regular $347). Lessons in Magic is also offered at $135 USD.
left_out: Shift free event dated 2026-10-31 (one-off live event, not evergreen).

Own courses: How to Use Tarot for Healing / Tarot Therapy Training and The Sleep Clinic (health framing, borderline); How to Stay Sane in an Insane World (mental-health framing, borderline); Trauma & Creativity (condition-named); Introduction to Psychosynthesis and Psychosynthesis Training (run by other organisations, Alef Trust / Onlinevents); Ancestral Lore & Nature Spirituality (Advaya page returns 'Course Not Found'); The Silva Method & Sophrology (£25 taster, left out for the cap); OBOD's own Bardic course (belongs to OBOD, not him).

Videos: Tea with a Druid 239 (Depression) and 205 (easing sorrow), How to Use the Tarot for Health & Healing, Psychedelic Psychotherapy, Druidry & the Trees, Winter Solstice 2021 (dated), short clips under ~2 minutes, interviews where a guest is the main speaker, and political/short commentary.

Books: Time for Magic (lead author Jamie Reid); The Prophecies (novel); Sacred Nature Healing Meditations (health framing); A Brief History of Nakedness, The Opera Tarot, The Winged Psyche, Empower Your Life with Sophrology, Druidcraft, Sacred Places and others for the 10-book cap or not checked on amazon.com.
Podcast This Magical Life and the free book for blog subscribers — not a listed resource type / email-gated.
